seo.title: Coalition calculator & parliament chart maker | Parliament Seats
seo.description: Free coalition and majority calculator for the EU, Germany, the UK, Spain, Canada, France and more. Build a coalition, then share it as a link, image or embed.
seo.socialTitle: Parliament Seats – Coalition calculator & parliament chart maker
seo.socialDescription: Build coalitions and check majorities in the European Parliament, the Bundestag, the House of Commons and more. Share them as links, images or embeds.
seo.imageAlt: Parliament Seats on a tablet and a phone, showing a coalition chart for a made-up parliament
seo.intro: Parliament Seats is a free tool for exploring how the seats in a parliament are shared out, and checking whether a coalition reaches a majority.
features: Coalition calculator with simple, three-fifths, two-thirds, three-quarters, and custom majorities, plus blocking minorities and an optional tie breaker
Seats from votes with the D'Hondt, Sainte-Laguë, and largest remainder methods, and an optional electoral threshold
Half-pie parliament chart and seat bar
Coalitions by political spectrum, from far left to far right
Custom parliaments with your own parties, seats, colours, name, and date
Share links, JSON import and export, PNG images for social media, and embeds for websites
Available in English, German, French, Dutch, Turkish, and Spanish
parliaments: Canada (House of Commons / Chambre des communes)
